name: invaradar-deck
description: Builds both InvaRadar decks (submission A4 and full 16:9) from outputs/*.json in the Ecopremia Moscow palette

scripts.brand: python3 brand_assets.py && python3 make_drone_scheme.py assets/umbel_leaves.jpg assets/drone_patches.jpg
scripts.qa: python3 qa/check_fonts.py InvaRadar_Ecopremia2026_podacha.pptx InvaRadar_Ecopremia2026.pptx && python3 qa/check_collisions.py InvaRadar_Ecopremia2026_podacha.pdf InvaRadar_Ecopremia2026.pdf
scripts.all: npm run build:submission && npm run build && npm run pdf && npm run qa
